element.name: StoreItems
element.event:
local numItems = element("numItems"):GetInt() for i=0,numItems-1 do element:RemoveElement(element:GetElement("storeItem"..(i))) end

element:parent()["StoreTitle"]["Text"]:DoStoredScript("onInit")

local numItems = store:NumCategoryItems() local numLocked = store:NumLockedItems() local rootItem = nil local previous = nil
local lockedIndex = numItems - numLocked
element("numItems"):SetInt(numItems)
for i = 0, numItems-1 do
local storeItem = menu:addTemplateElement("template_storeitem", "Store_" .. i, element)
storeItem("SpriteName"):SetString("portrait_frame") storeItem("SheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/hud01.xml") storeItem("ItemTitle"):SetString(store:ItemTitle(i))

-- If currency, store additional info if(store:Category() == 4) then storeItem("ItemName"):SetString(store:ItemName(i)) storeItem("ItemGroup"):SetString(store:ItemGroup(i)) end
storeItem:setName("storeItem"..(i))
if(previous == nil) then storeItem:relativeTo(element) storeItem:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(13 * (lua_sys.screenWidth()/480.0), 0, 18, lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.VCENTER)) storeItem:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.VCENTER) rootItem = storeItem previous = storeItem else storeItem:relativeTo(element) storeItem:setOrientation(lua_sys.MenuOrientation(previous("xOffset"):GetFloat() + previous:absW() + 13 * (lua_sys.screenWidth()/480.0), 0, 18, lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.VCENTER)) storeItem:setRelativeObjectAnchors(lua_sys.LEFT, lua_sys.VCENTER) previous = storeItem end

if(i >= lockedIndex) then storeItem:DoStoredScript("setLocked") end

end
